title: Rollout authorization workflow with evidence bundles and timeboxed approvals
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: our current model rollout flows (canary/A-B/shadow) lack a standardized, auditable signoff path that combines automated pre-checks with human timeboxed approvals and verifiable evidence. That increases risk for production regressions and complicates incident forensics.

Goal: design and ship an authorization workflow that: (1) runs a configurable suite of pre-flight automated checks, (2) generates an immutable evidence bundle signed with customer or platform KMS, (3) presents a timeboxed approval queue to role-based approvers, (4) attaches structured approval metadata and attestation tokens to the deployment event, and (5) integrates with auto-rollback triggers and audit logging.

Scope: the work covers console UX for approvals, API/SDK endpoints to request/complete approvals, RBAC templates for approver roles, evidence bundle format, signing/retention policy, integration points with canary/A-B/shadow pipelines, and backend audit canonicalization. Out of scope: full legal compliance review (handled separately) and per-customer custom retention policies for GA (pilot will use platform defaults).
acceptance_criteria: Automated pre-checks run as part of every staged rollout and return pass/fail codes to the approval queue
Evidence bundle (metrics snapshot, sample responses, model version, config diff) is produced and stored; bundle has an HMAC/KMS signature
Approval flow includes timebox parameter (default 4h) and auto-expire behavior that returns deployment to 'blocked' state if no approver acts
RBAC roles shipped: 'canary-approver', 'sre-reviewer', 'governance-auditor' with least-privilege bindings
Console shows a compact approval card with required approvers, evidence preview, TTL, and one-click approve/deny; actions are recorded in audit log with attestation token
Rollback policy hooks observe the same evidence bundle and can trigger automated rollback when configured thresholds are breached
API endpoints /v1/rollouts/{id}/request-approval and /v1/rollouts/{id}/complete-approval documented and covered by e2e tests
Audit logs contain canonicalized metadata for each approval event and evidence bundle location for at least 1 year (pilot)
tasks: Design evidence bundle schema (fields, retention, signing) - coordinate with Security
Define RBAC role templates and default bindings for orgs - coordinate with Platform
Implement pre-check runner and integration with existing canary/A-B pipelines (ENG)
Backend: approval queue, TTL enforcement, attestation token generation
Console: approval card UX and evidence preview
API: endpoints and docs for requesting/completing approvals
Integration tests: simulate canary with failed pre-check leading to blocked approval
Run a 2-week pilot with two customer-facing teams and collect feedback
